Firewall_Policy (object)
Configures firewall policy
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
class*
string
“Firewall_Policy”
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
routeDomainEnforcement
array
Specifies Route Domains to enforce this policy on. Rules of this policy will be enforced on the Route Domains. If setting this property, the Firewall_Policy must be defined in /Common/Shared.
rules*
array
A list of firewall policy rules
